title: Free character orbits solve scalar cocycles but a compact-group transfer requires cross-orbit additivity

statement.quantifiers: Countably infinite torsion-free G acting mixingly on compact F2-module D; measurable D-valued twisted cocycle beta on Y.
statement.assertion: Each nonzero dual-character orbit admits exact measurable scalar transfers. A simultaneous D-valued transfer exists iff scalar transfers can be chosen with u0=1 and u_(eta+xi)=u_eta u_xi for every pair.
assumptions: Mixing makes nonzero character stabilizers finite; torsion-free makes them trivial.
Countable character/group family and measurable beta satisfying the exact twisted identity.
For application beta=alpha(g,jy)−sigma alpha(g,y), with j equivariant and sigma commuting with G.

inputs: Inherited residual extension, supplied j and fibre automorphism, exact cocycle beta.
outputs: Explicit orbitwise solutions and a necessary/sufficient coherence interface; no acquired coherent global family.
interface.precision: All equations simultaneous on a common conull set; approximate or finitely tested identities do not suffice.
costs: Orbit representatives and measurable existence do not supply a finite-bit or efficient compiler.
Actual witness and mixing are separate source premises, not verified by this extraction.

proof_mechanism: Choose eta0 per free character orbit, u_eta0=1 and u_(g^-1eta0)(y)=b_eta0(g,y)^−1.
Twisted cocycle identity verifies scalar equations for every character on that orbit.
Cross-orbit multiplication makes eta-to-u_eta a character of the discrete dual; Pontryagin duality reconstructs a measurable D-valued t.
obstructions: Arbitrary per-orbit solutions need not be multiplicatively coherent.
Fixed G-permuted basis of nonprojective residual dual impossible, but environment-dependent coherence is not excluded.
No unequal-entropy Bernoulli conjugacy or all-measurable obstruction follows.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Acquire j/sigma and a multiplicatively coherent family, or a precise equivariant displacement lift; scalar orbit solutions alone are insufficient.

review.source_reported: Source exact written derivation reported; no diagnostics supplied; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
